blocks.text: 66. So then, that the Son of God should be born, and in what manner born, and where He was to be born, and that Christ is the one eternal King [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-178] the prophets thus declared. And again they told beforehand concerning Him how, sprung from mankind, He should heal those whom He healed, and raise the dead whom He raised, and be hated and despised and undergo sufferings and be put to death and crucified, even as He was hated and despised and put to death.
